content.title: Nebraska hosts Spring Game
content.text: clickSkip to contentLINCOLN, Neb. (KOLN) - The Nebraska football team wrapped up its spring season with the Red vs. White Scrimmage on Saturday at Memorial Stadium.The Red Team won over the White Team, 22-17. The intrasquad scrimmage marked the unofficial debut for a number of Nebraska newcomers, including quarterback Anthony Colandrea. Head coach Matt Rhule described the 15-practice season as quiet and focused. The Huskers worked under-the-radar while most of the fans’ attention was on the men’s basketball team’s historic run in the NCAA Tournament.Watch coverage at 6 and 10 p.m. on 10/11.
